ruling: R9. Review rounds. A change is done at the first round that passes, guard or check changes included. A fix after a pass, lint-only or a finding fix, is checked by a fix verifier, and its pass ends review. Round 3 runs only when round 2 FAILS. Round 4 needs the owner's grant. The net-value test runs only on a guard or check change that reaches round 3 and cannot finish there. Evidence (consultant's count, unchecked by triage): round 3 found a failure 0 of 14+ times after a clean round 2; the net-value hold caught 6 real holes. Models per role: agent-model-cap. Homes: decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3, CLAUDE.md roles-review-cap-three and roles-third-round-steps-up (its stale clause "Only a guard or check change fixed under a fix verifier also waits for round 3" is still to be rewritten; owner's yes needed), merge tool (step merge-lint-fix-no-round-3, #3269). Confirmed by the owner in chat 18:35 CST Nov 13, reported by the consultant (18:36 CST): "that's correct". Rewritten in place; the Nov 10 layers (15:44 and 16:07 CST) are replaced.
